status: Published BAM reuse for simulation screening; stock 5V calibration and firmware parity remain unverified.
gain_notes: Explicit stock XL330 control-table default and BAM constructor default. P400 selected after the P200 Microduck reference slowly crouched onto its rear knee brackets in a 60s stand simulation; retain that failed comparison. This does not resolve BAM's divisor256 versus manual128 fidelity gap.
delay_notes: Assumed fixed command delay, not identified hardware latency. One physics-step queue only. At 2ms timestep, 20ms is 10 steps. Microduck's 3-6 actuation steps at 5ms imply 15-30ms; observation delay is separate.
firmware_notes: P-only BAM voltage controller. Its empirical P divisor is 256, whereas the manual documents 128. No profile generator, PWM slew, I/D/feedforward, thermal protection, backlash or sensor/communication model is implemented here. The 1.75A BAM winding-current limiter is not a validated model of the XL330 input-current register.
fidelity_gate: OPEN: establish exact actuator variant, fit acquisition voltage, firmware version/mode/PWM slope and gain scaling from existing published evidence. Do not ask the owner to characterize servos.
